correctness.rationale: This is a correct fixed-m asymptotic for full idempotents. For a rooted fiber of s blocks, the r image points are fixed, so the r-point fiber rank weight is binom(n,r) r^(sn−r), independent of choices at other roots given the block map. Writing t=r log n/n, the normalized log weight has t-dependent term s log t−t plus the two corrections of (6). The latter are bounded globally by 1/e+log 2 and uniformly vanish on compact positive t-intervals (the binomial term is bounded by binary entropy). Because s log t−t tends to minus infinity at both endpoints and has a nondegenerate unique maximum at s, an integer nearest sn/log n yields the matching lower bound; outside any fixed neighborhood the weights have a strict n-scale gap. At most n summands do not affect this scale. Subtracting the logarithmic normalizer yields (1). For fixed k, strict discrete convexity moves one unit from the smaller of any two nonsingleton parts to the larger and uniquely leaves profile (m−k+1,1,…,1); the finite number of possible maps gives (2) and then (3). Rank concentration holds for each fixed block map and hence for the finite unconditional mixture. Label symmetry gives exact conditional uniformity of the unique root. Formula (1) follows by subtraction of logarithms, not literal division of equations (9) and (10). The supplied checker was inspected, not executed; the finite checks do not justify the asymptotics.

originality.rationale: Distinct published catalogue record 2dc6ac2af32e covers the mathematical content, not just the same monoid or a similar big-O estimate. Its equation (1) and proof steps 2–3 give the more general near-equal-block saddle, conditional concentration, log weight for every block map, and normalization by the one-root weights. Setting every block size to n gives the frozen theorem's starting asymptotic estimates verbatim; normalization and fixed-k convexity give all of the displayed rates. The other record explicitly describes equal-block entropy suppression as earlier work without giving an identifying citation in its relevant passage. The records share a catalogue date, which determines neither priority nor provenance; the FAIL is for demonstrated coverage and lack of a distinct mathematical claim, not a finding about first proof or authorship. No repair is submitted: the other advertised conclusions are mechanical consequences too, and a new fluctuation or rate theorem would require new mathematics.
residual_risks: Neither the common catalogue date nor the generic earlier-work reference in 2dc6ac2af32e determines which text was first or whether one used the other.
A deferred primary literature lookup is not negative evidence; the decision rests on independently inspected, concrete mathematical coverage.
